question: AMD MI300X 的显存带宽为 5300 GB/s (HBM3)，显存容量为 192 GB，该参数使其在 BF16 精度下的理论 Decode 吞吐率可达 ~100 Tokens/s，远超 NVIDIA 消费级显卡。

sources.title: AMD Instinct™ MI300X Accelerators
sources.snippet: AMD Instinct™ MI300X accelerators are designed to deliver leadership performance for Generative AI workloads and HPC applications.

sources.title: PDF AMD Instinct MI300X Accelerator
sources.snippet: AMD Instinct accelerators facilitate large models with shared memory and caches. The large amount of HBM3 memory is supported with 5.3 TB/s of local bandwidth, and direct connectivity of 128 GB/s bidirectional bandwidth between each GPU, accelerating memory-intensive AI, ML, and HPC models.
